messages:
olivia: @channel v3 is GA — streaming + tool-calling are production-ready. New model variants live: redwood-mosaic-pro-2 (high-quality), mosaic-lite-quant (cost-optimized). Deprecating /v2 gen endpoints in 90 days. Please read migration notes below. :tada:

sanjay: congrats! quick Q — exact retirement date for v2?

olivia: 90 days from today (1812345678). We'll send deprecation emails, console banners, and a migration guide with examples.

marta: Docs: I've got a draft migration guide and swagger diffs. Waiting on final example responses for tool-calls. Will push preview link shortly.

docs-bot: Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/v3-gen-migration (pr #431)

kevin: Infra rollout plan: canary at 1% -> 10% -> 50% over ~4h with health gates. Autoscale profiles updated for the new gen instance types. Monitoring team, watch GPU memory + preempt events.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for infra-pool-alpha at 1812345800

anya: SRE ops: added dashboards for gen.latency.{p50,p95}, streaming.session_errors, toolcall.err_rate, cache.hit_ratio. New alerts: p95 > 700ms OR toolcall.err_rate > 0.75% -> page oncall. Synthetic streaming session tests deployed every 60s.

sam: Legal note: tool-calling requires customers to declare external integrations. Privacy policy update staged; will need console consent flows for tool scopes.

kevin: Auth unchanged (API key). New optional params: `model_variant`, `streaming:true`, `allow_tool_calls:true`. Example curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v3/gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mosaic-pro-2","model_variant":"hq","streaming":true,"input":"Summarize the design doc","allow_tool_calls":true}'
```

marta: SDKs: node/python streaming helpers and toolcall wrappers will land in the next patch. Ill own the SDK PRs and update quickstarts.

sanjay: any recommended default for cost-sensitive routes?

olivia: use mosaic-lite-quant or set fallback_policy=cost_optimized. We also added an automatic low-cost fallback in routing config for teams that opt in.

anya: Failover: automatic fallback to mosaic-lite-quant if p95 latency breaches SLA for a route. Also configured muted retries for transient toolcall 5xxs.

kevin: Rollback plan: flip feature-flag routing or route all gen traffic to the v2 traffic group. Estimated full rollback < 30m. Keep oncall informed during canary.

marta: I'll sync the docs preview with engineering examples post-canary.

olivia: Customer comms: marketing will send GA announcement + migration checklist tomorrow morning. Ops will monitor the first 6 hours closely.

kevin: Heads-up for eng testers: use header `X-Canary-Key` for internal canary traffic. I'll DM keys to folks.

olivia: Thanks everyone. If you see anomalies, ping #eng-oncall and tag @anya. Celebratory GIFs encouraged. :rocket:
